cards.t: Recommendation systems: why the Internet 'knows' you
cards.tz: 推荐系统：为什么网络比你更懂你
cards.en:
Platforms such as e-commerce and social media sites use recommendation systems to redirect users to their sites and increase website traffic. Personalised recommendations also distribute traffic to relevant pages to optimise user experience and keep visitors on the website longer.

A recommendation system works in two steps: it tracks your activities with big data (chats, searches, clicks, location) and then predicts your actions with artificial intelligence algorithms. The textbook story: you chat with friends about travel in a messaging app; the social platform then suggests overseas restaurants; the video platform recommends travel vlogs; and a shopping app pushes a sale of travel accessories.

Exam key point: recommendation = big data (collect/track) + AI (predict). Benefits: relevant content, convenience, more sales for the company. Concerns: privacy (data collected without users noticing), filter bubbles, over-spending.
cards.zh:
电商和社交媒体网站广泛使用 recommendation systems（推荐系统），把用户引回自己的网站，increase website traffic；个性化推荐还把流量分配到相关页面，optimise user experience，让访客停留更久。

推荐系统分两步：先用 big data 追踪你的活动（聊天、搜索、点击、位置），再用 AI algorithms 预测你的行为。课本例子：你在通讯软件和朋友聊旅行 → 社交平台推荐海外餐厅 → 视频平台推荐旅行 vlog → 购物 app 推送旅行用品减价。

考试要点：推荐 = big data（收集）+ AI（预测）。好处：内容相关、方便、公司销量增加；隐忧：privacy（数据在不知不觉中被收集）、信息茧房、过度消费。

ex.q: After searching for running shoes once, Mary sees shoe ads on several websites. Explain how this happens.
ex.a: Her search, clicks and cookies are collected as big data (tracking). An AI algorithm analyses the data, predicts she is interested in running shoes, and the ad/recommendation system shows related products across platforms.
ex.az: 搜索、点击、cookies 被收集成大数据；AI 分析并预测她对跑鞋有兴趣，于是在不同平台推送相关广告。

cards.en:
Data are collected from a variety of sources, including detectors (sensors) in the Internet of Things (IoT). When the volume of data collected is big enough, these data can be integrated into large data sets for further analysis. These data sets are called big data.

The 4 V's:
  • Volume: a large amount of data, requiring instant collection and analysis using cloud. Challenge: storage of the growing data.
  • Variety: a wide range of data types: audio, image, video, text, location. Challenge: integration of different data sources.
  • Velocity: high speed of data generation and analysis. Challenge: effective and timely evaluation.
  • Veracity: the uncertainty of data. Challenge: data accuracy and quality.
Enrichment: extra V's are value, variability and visualisation.

Data are collected at any moment: clicks, browsing history, cookies and cache, even clipboards. Combined with time, location and age, they generate valuable analytical results.
cards.zh:
数据来自各种来源，包括 IoT（物联网） 里的感应器。数据量够大时可整合成大型数据集作进一步分析，这就是 big data（大数据）。

4V：
  • Volume 数据量：数据量巨大，需用云端即时收集和分析；挑战：storage of the growing data。
  • Variety 多样性：音频、图像、视频、文字、位置等多种类型；挑战：integration of different data sources。
  • Velocity 速度：数据产生和分析速度快；挑战：effective and timely evaluation。
  • Veracity 准确性：数据的不确定性；挑战：data accuracy and quality。
延伸：还有 value（价值）、variability（多变性）、visualisation（视觉化）。

数据随时被收集：点击、浏览记录、cookies 和 cache（快取记忆体）、甚至剪贴板，再结合时间、位置、年龄，就能得出有价值的分析结果。

ex.q: '47% of email is spam.' Which V does this statistic illustrate, and what is the challenge?
ex.a: Veracity, the uncertainty of data. The challenge is ensuring data accuracy and quality before analysis (e.g. filtering out spam/fake data).
ex.az: Veracity（准确性）；挑战是保证数据的准确和质量。

ex.q: Google changed its traffic prediction algorithm in 2020 because traffic patterns changed suddenly in the pandemic. Which V?
ex.a: Velocity: data are generated quickly and the analysis must be effective and timely, so models must adapt fast.
ex.az: Velocity：数据变化快，需要及时评估。

cards.en:
The textbook's 2021 statistics illustrate each V:
  • Volume: 4.8 billion Internet users; 5 billion Google searches per day; 1.8 billion websites.
  • Variety: 500 billion tweets (per the figure); 5 billion YouTube videos viewed per day; 1 billion km driven with Google Maps per day; 60 million Instagram photos.
  • Velocity: 2 million emails sent per second; RMB 498 billion sales during the 2020 Double 11 festival on Taobao; Google's traffic algorithm changed for the pandemic.
  • Veracity: 47% of email is spam.
You do not need to memorise the exact numbers. What matters is matching an example to the correct V and stating its challenge. Mixed types of data (photos + videos + GPS) point to variety; huge amounts point to volume; data per second or real-time change points to velocity; fake, spam, or wrong data point to veracity.
cards.zh:
课本用 2021 年的数据说明每个 V：
  • Volume：48 亿网民；每天 50 亿次 Google 搜索；18 亿个网站。
  • Variety：推文、每天 50 亿次 YouTube 观看、每天 10 亿公里 Google Maps 导航、Instagram 照片。
  • Velocity：每秒 200 万封电邮；2020 年淘宝双十一 4980 亿人民币销售额；Google 因疫情修改交通预测算法。
  • Veracity：47% 电邮是垃圾邮件。
不用背数字，重点是把例子对应到正确的 V 并说出挑战：类型混杂 → variety；数量巨大 → volume；每秒/实时变化 → velocity；假、垃圾、错误数据 → veracity。

ex.q: A smart city collects CCTV video, temperature readings and Octopus card transactions. Which V is best illustrated?
ex.a: Variety: video, numbers and transaction records are different data types; the challenge is integrating different data sources.
ex.az: Variety：数据类型不同，难点是整合。

cards.en:
Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the intelligence of machines that often involves heuristic programs to allow the machines to learn from experience and make decisions like humans. AI reduces our burden by performing tasks that could only be achieved by humans before.

A heuristic (認知捷徑) is a problem-solving strategy that discovers effective decisions through previous experience. It does not guarantee the perfect answer, but finds a good answer quickly (a 'rule of thumb').

Exam definition to memorise: AI is the intelligence of machines that often involves heuristic programs to allow machines to learn from experience and make decisions like humans.

Application & career: an Oxford report said 47% of US workers might lose jobs to computerisation; simple, repetitive jobs (restaurant servers, drivers, cashiers, accountants, translators) are at risk, e.g. self-checkouts. But AI also creates jobs: LinkedIn 2020 named AI specialist, data protection officer and robotics engineer as the top three emerging jobs. Humans can focus on higher-order thinking and creativity.
cards.zh:
Artificial Intelligence（AI，人工智能）是机器的智能，通常使用 heuristic programs（认知捷径程序），让机器从经验中学习并像人一样作决定。AI 能代替以前只能由人完成的工作，减轻负担。

Heuristic 是一种从过往经验中找出有效决定的解难策略，不保证完美答案，但能快速找到不错的答案（经验法则）。

要背的定义：AI is the intelligence of machines that often involves heuristic programs to allow machines to learn from experience and make decisions like humans.

应用与职业：牛津大学报告指 47% 美国工人可能因电脑化失业；简单重复、不需创意的工作（侍应、司机、收银员、会计、翻译）风险高，例如自助收银。但 AI 也创造新工作：LinkedIn 2020 报告前三名新兴职业是 AI specialist、data protection officer、robotics engineer。人类可专注高阶思维和创意。

ex.q: Give one job at high risk of being replaced by AI and one new job created by AI, with reasons.
ex.a: At risk: cashier: the task is simple and repetitive and can be done by self-checkout. New job: AI specialist / data protection officer: needed to build AI systems and protect the large amounts of personal data they use.
ex.az: 高风险：收银员（重复工作，可被自助收银取代）；新职业：AI 专家／数据保护主任。

cards.en:
Machine learning is the process of a machine training itself by reading sample data. It lets us teach machines complex algorithms without having to program each and every detail manually. We only provide sample data; the computer automatically looks for patterns and generates a model that provides a solution.

The four steps (memorise the order):
  1. Provide data
  2. Find patterns
  3. Generate model
  4. Obtain predictions
Contrast with traditional programming: a programmer writes explicit rules (if colour = red and shape = round then 'apple'). In machine learning, the rules are learnt from examples. Generally, more (and better) samples give more accurate output.

Lab 1.1 Teachable Machine: (1) rename classes and add sample images (upload or webcam); (2) click 'Train Model'; (3) upload a new image not used in training to test the model. It can be trained to identify images, audio and poses.
cards.zh:
Machine learning（机器学习）是机器通过阅读样本数据训练自己的过程。我们不用逐一手动编写每个细节，只需提供样本数据，电脑会自动找出规律并生成模型来解决问题。

四个步骤（记顺序）：
  1. Provide data 提供数据
  2. Find patterns 找规律
  3. Generate model 生成模型
  4. Obtain predictions 得出预测
和传统编程对比：传统是程序员写明规则（如果红色又圆就是苹果）；机器学习是从例子中学出规则。样本越多越好，输出越准确。

Lab 1.1 Teachable Machine：(1) 改类别名并加入样本图片（上传或网络摄像头）；(2) 按 Train Model；(3) 上传一张没用过的新图片测试模型。可训练识别图像、声音和姿势。

ex.q: In Teachable Machine, why must the test image be one that was NOT used as a training sample?
ex.a: To check that the model can generalise, i.e. recognise new data using the patterns it learnt, not just remember the training images. Testing with a training image would overstate the accuracy.
ex.az: 要测试模型能否用学到的规律识别新数据，而不只是记住样本。

cards.tz: 监督式与非监督式学习
cards.en:
Supervised learning (監督式學習): humans train a computer with labelled datasets so it learns how to identify data and predict results (like learning from a teacher).
Unsupervised learning (非監督式學習): the computer uses algorithms to identify patterns in unlabelled datasets to make classifications and predictions, without human guidance (like learning from your own observations).

Table 1.1:
SupervisedUnsupervised
AlgorithmMore explicit; improves automatically with training data; makes informed decisionsLess explicit; artificial neural networks allow more complex problems
Training dataLess; usually structured/labelledMore; usually unlabelled
Training timeShorterLonger
Tip: look for the word 'label'. Photos tagged 'cat'/'dog' → supervised. Grouping customers into groups nobody defined in advance → unsupervised.
cards.zh:
Supervised learning（监督式学习）：人类用已标签（labelled）的数据训练电脑，让它学会识别数据和预测结果（像有老师教）。
Unsupervised learning（非监督式学习）：电脑用算法在未标签数据中找规律来分类和预测，不需人类指导（像自己观察学习）。

表 1.1：
监督式非监督式
算法较明确；随训练数据自动改进；作有根据的决定较不明确；用人工神经网络处理更复杂问题
训练数据较少；通常是结构化/有标签较多；通常无标签
训练时间较短较长
技巧：看有没有'label'。已标'猫/狗'的照片 → 监督式；把顾客分成事先没定义的组 → 非监督式。

ex.q: A bank feeds 10,000 past transactions, each marked 'fraud' or 'normal', into a model. Supervised or unsupervised? Why?
ex.a: Supervised, because every training record is labelled (fraud/normal) by humans, and the model learns to predict the label of new transactions.
ex.az: 监督式，因为每笔交易都有人类给的标签。

ex.q: A shop groups customers by buying habits without predefined groups. Which type?
ex.a: Unsupervised: the data are unlabelled and the algorithm finds the patterns (clusters) itself.
ex.az: 非监督式：数据无标签，算法自己找分组。

cards.t: Deep learning and artificial neural networks
cards.tz: 深度学习与人工神经网络
cards.en:
Deep learning (enrichment): as computational power has drastically increased, we can train machines with higher complexity. Machines discover hidden connections by completing training more thoroughly, and accomplish tasks no humans can do, leading to breakthroughs in self-driving, Go and fraud detection. Example: AlphaGo defeated the world Go champions.

Artificial neural network (STEAM+): a set of algorithms inspired by the human brain and designed to recognise patterns. It receives, processes and transmits information like the nervous system (formed by interlinked neurons). Structure: an input layer → one or more hidden layers → an output layer; each node connects to nodes in the next layer.

Link: neural networks are used in unsupervised learning to solve more complex problems; 'deep' means many hidden layers.
cards.zh:
Deep learning（深度学习）（延伸）：电脑运算能力大增，可以训练更复杂的机器。机器经更彻底的训练发现隐藏关联，完成人类做不到的事，带来自动驾驶、围棋、欺诈侦测等突破。例子：AlphaGo 击败世界围棋冠军。

Artificial neural network（人工神经网络）（STEAM+）：一组受人脑启发、用来识别规律的算法，像神经系统（由互相连接的神经元组成）一样接收、处理和传送信息。结构：input layer（输入层） → 一层或多层 hidden layers（隐藏层） → output layer（输出层），每个节点连到下一层的节点。

联系：非监督式学习用神经网络处理更复杂的问题；'deep' 指有很多隐藏层。

ex.q: Name the three types of layer in an artificial neural network and state where the result appears.
ex.a: Input layer, hidden layer(s), output layer. The result (prediction/classification) appears at the output layer.
ex.az: 输入层、隐藏层、输出层；结果在输出层。

cards.en:
Pattern recognition (模式識別) is the process of finding the similarities, relationships or patterns that can be further used to analyse and solve complex problems more efficiently. AI learns to solve problems like humans by using machine learning algorithms: it first identifies and categorises the data, then generates the most possible output.

Activity 1.1: humans easily pick all pancake images in a reCAPTCHA, or predict the next shape in a sequence (triangle 3 sides, square 4, pentagon 5 → next is a hexagon, 6 sides). We recognise the pattern without thinking.

Fig. 1.6, two stages:
  • Stage I Training: a set of data (cat and dog photos) → learning → classification into Dog and Cat.
  • Stage II Prediction: input a new picture ('What is this?') → the classifier that learnt from datasets → output 'Dog'.
Three applications in the summary: image recognition, speech recognition, spam detection.
cards.zh:
Pattern recognition（模式识别）是找出相似之处、关系或规律，再用来更有效地分析和解决复杂问题的过程。AI 用机器学习算法像人一样解难：先识别并分类数据，再产生最可能的输出。

Activity 1.1：人类很容易在 reCAPTCHA 中选出所有班戟图片，或预测图形序列的下一个（三角形 3 边、正方形 4、五边形 5 → 下一个是 6 边的六边形）。

图 1.6 两个阶段：
  • Stage I Training 训练：一组数据（猫狗照片）→ 学习 → 分类成 Dog 和 Cat。
  • Stage II Prediction 预测：输入新图片 → 由数据学成的 classifier → 输出 'Dog'。
章节小结的三个应用：image recognition、speech recognition、spam detection。

ex.q: Triangle, square, pentagon, ? Which shape comes next and what pattern is used?
ex.a: A hexagon. Pattern: the number of sides increases by 1 each time (3, 4, 5 → 6).
ex.az: 六边形；边数每次加 1。

cards.en:
AI can recognise patterns within images. Images in computers are formed by pixels. To recognise images, an AI model gathers training data by scanning the pixels on different images. By grouping the pixels together, it can analyse and identify the features of different objects (patterns and edges). When the same pattern is detected again in the future, the AI model recognises the object.

Examples: object identification (a greyscale face as a grid of pixel values), signature recognition.

Lab 1.2:
  • Mission 1 Reverse image search: Google Images, click the camera icon, paste an image URL or upload an image; used in product search on shopping sites when you do not know the keywords (e.g. it recognised the fish species).
  • Mission 2 Doodling recognition (AutoDraw): uses machine learning to guess what you are drawing and pairs it with drawings by artists.
  • Mission 3 Quick, Draw!: millions of doodles collected form a large data set; the AI learns from it and improves over time.
cards.zh:
AI 可以识别图像中的规律。电脑中的图像由像素（pixels）组成。AI 模型扫描不同图像的像素收集训练数据，把像素归组后分析和识别不同物件的特征（图案和边缘）。将来再侦测到相同规律时就能认出物件。

例子：物件识别（灰阶人脸=一格格像素值）、签名识别。

Lab 1.2：
  • 以图搜图（reverse image search）：Google Images 按相机图示，贴图片网址或上传；购物网站上不知道关键字时找类似产品（例如认出鱼的品种）。
  • AutoDraw 涂鸦识别：用机器学习猜你画什么，配对艺术家画好的图。
  • Quick, Draw!：收集数以百万计的涂鸦成大型数据集，AI 从中学习，识别能力随时间提升。

ex.q: Explain why Quick, Draw! becomes better at guessing over time.
ex.a: Each player's drawing is added to its data set. With more training samples the model finds more reliable patterns, so its recognition accuracy improves.
ex.az: 每次涂鸦都加入数据集；样本越多，规律越可靠，准确度提高。

cards.en:
Facial recognition (人臉識別) is built upon the concept of image recognition. The AI captures the specific features on one's face, such as wrinkles, skin tone or other facial details. We can verify the identity of a person just by searching for those unique features. It detects and matches the human face against a database of faces.

Applications: tag suggestions on photo storage sites and social media; face filters using AR technology together with face recognition; phone unlocking; border control.

Concerns (link to 1.1F ethics): face data are biometric personal data; leaks cannot be fixed by 'changing your face'; mass surveillance; possible discriminatory outcomes if training data are biased (e.g. lower accuracy for some skin tones).
cards.zh:
Facial recognition（人脸识别）建基于影像识别。AI 捕捉脸上的独特特征，例如皱纹、肤色或其他细节，只要搜寻这些特征就能核实一个人的身份：把人脸和人脸数据库比对。

应用：相片储存网站和社交平台的标签建议；结合 AR 的人脸滤镜；手机解锁；过关。

隐忧（连到 1.1F 伦理）：人脸是生物特征个人资料，外泄后无法'换脸'；大规模监控；训练数据有偏差时可能出现歧视性结果（如某些肤色准确度较低）。

ex.q: A social media site suggests tagging your friend in a new photo. Explain how.
ex.a: Facial recognition extracts features (eyes, nose shape, skin tone…) from the face in the photo and matches them against the database of faces already tagged; the best match is suggested.
ex.az: 提取脸部特征，与已标签的人脸数据库比对，最接近的就作建议。

cards.en:
A digital video is a collection of frames, so video recognition is largely similar to image recognition. However, a more comprehensive analysis is needed because there are multiple continuous frames to capture from. With video recognition we can do video classification, object tracking, and even use machines with high accuracy to perform action prediction.

Main application: self-driving vehicles. They use video recognition to identify the distance between the vehicle and other objects, such as road signs. By analysing multiple frames and combining the analyses, the algorithm can react to unexpected events and recognise road signs.

Ethics link: who is accountable when a self-driving car causes an accident (Fig. 1.18)?
cards.zh:
数码视频是一连串帧（frames），所以视频识别和影像识别大致相同，但因为要从多个连续帧中提取，需要更全面的分析。视频识别可做视频分类、物件追踪，甚至高准确度的动作预测。

主要应用：自动驾驶车辆，用视频识别判断车辆与其他物件（如路牌）的距离；分析多帧并合并结果，算法就能对突发事件作出反应并识别路牌。

伦理：自动驾驶车撞车，谁负责（图 1.18）？

ex.q: Why is video recognition harder than image recognition?
ex.a: A video contains many continuous frames; the system must analyse each frame and combine the results over time (e.g. to track motion or predict actions), which needs a more comprehensive analysis and more processing power.
ex.az: 视频有很多连续帧，要逐帧分析并合并，需要更全面的分析。

cards.en:
We can distinguish different people's voices because they have different pitches (frequency) and volumes (amplitude) at different time intervals, forming unique waveforms. These features are captured through digitalisation: the sound wave is sampled (its value measured at fixed time intervals). A trained algorithm learns and identifies the features in digitised waveforms of each word, so it can detect regular patterns and identify words; patterns in audio waves are recognised and converted into readable text.

Speech recognition allows computers to convert human speech into written format, used in voice typing and voice commands.

Lab 1.3: Google Assistant, 'What's this song?'. Music recognition matches lyrics and melody with the database and tells users the song's name. Alarm detection / sound recognition recognises fire alarms, sirens and doorbells and alerts people with hearing impairment.

Digital assistants and chatbots use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to translate human speech into language machines understand, then complete tasks.
cards.zh:
我们能分辨不同人的声音，因为不同时间的音高（频率 frequency）和音量（振幅 amplitude）不同，形成独特波形。这些特征透过数码化（digitalisation）捕捉：在固定时间间隔取样（sampling）声波的数值。训练好的算法学习每个字数码波形的特征，侦测规律并认出字词，再转成可读文字。

Speech recognition allows computers to convert human speech into written format，用于语音输入和语音指令。

Lab 1.3：Google Assistant 问 'What's this song?'；音乐识别把歌词和旋律与数据库比对，告诉你歌名。警报/声音识别可认出火警、警笛、门铃，提醒听障人士。

数码助理和聊天机械人用 NLP（自然语言处理）把人话翻成机器懂的语言，再执行指令。

ex.q: State the two features of a voice that make each person's waveform unique, and the process that captures them.
ex.a: Pitch (frequency) and volume (amplitude) at different time intervals; captured by digitalisation (sampling the sound wave at fixed intervals).
ex.az: 音高（频率）和音量（振幅）；透过数码化（取样）捕捉。

cards.en:
AI blocks about 100 million spam messages every day. It blocks easily detectable text-based spam and also image-based messages, emails with hidden embedded content, and messages from newly registered domains.

There is no exact definition of spam, so the AI customises the filter by recording our preferences when we press 'Report spam' or move an email out of the spam folder ('Not spam'). This is training through manual classification: users give labels, which is supervised learning.

Enrichment: 'Everyone has been an AI trainer for years'. CAPTCHAs (人機驗證) block spammers by distinguishing humans from computers. Google's reCAPTCHA is based on text and image recognition tasks. The words were scanned from books that Optical Character Recognition (OCR) failed to convert into editable text, so by solving CAPTCHAs we helped digitise printed materials. Image/number tasks help train image recognition (e.g. street signs, house numbers for maps and self-driving).
cards.zh:
AI 每天拦截约 1 亿封垃圾邮件，不只拦截易认的文字垃圾，还包括图片型讯息、内藏嵌入内容的电邮、新注册网域发出的讯息。

Spam 没有确切定义，所以 AI 记录我们的偏好来自订过滤器：按 'Report spam' 或把邮件移出垃圾箱（'Not spam'）。这是人手分类训练，用户提供标签，即监督式学习。

延伸：'每个人都当了多年 AI 训练员'。CAPTCHA（人机验证）区分人类和电脑以阻挡垃圾发送者；reCAPTCHA 用文字和图像识别任务。那些字是 OCR（光符识别）未能转成可编辑文字的书本扫描字，解 CAPTCHA 就是帮忙数码化印刷品；图片/数字题则帮助训练影像识别（路牌、门牌，用于地图和自动驾驶）。

ex.q: Explain how pressing 'Not spam' improves the filter.
ex.a: It gives the AI a labelled example (this email = not spam) reflecting the user's preference. The filter retrains/adjusts its patterns, so similar emails are not classified as spam in future.
ex.az: 提供一个有标签的样本，过滤器据此调整规律。

cards.en:
Optical Character Recognition (OCR, 光符識別) converts images of printed or handwritten text (from a scanner or camera) into editable, machine-readable text. It is a form of image/pattern recognition: the shapes of characters are matched with learnt patterns.

Where OCR appears in this chapter:
  • reCAPTCHA used words that OCR failed to read, so humans solving the CAPTCHA helped digitise books.
  • Google Translate instant camera translation (Activity 1.5) combines OCR + AR: OCR reads the menu text in the camera image, machine translation translates it, and AR overlays the translation onto the live picture. 'Detect language' helps when the source language is unknown.
Benefit: you can translate a language you cannot even type.
cards.zh:
OCR（Optical Character Recognition，光符识别）把扫描器或相机拍到的印刷/手写文字图像转成可编辑、机器可读的文字，属于影像/模式识别：把字形与学到的规律比对。

本章出现的地方：
  • reCAPTCHA 用 OCR 认不出的字，人类解题就是帮忙把书数码化。
  • Google Translate 即时相机翻译（Activity 1.5）= OCR + AR：OCR 读出镜头中餐牌文字，机器翻译，再用 AR 把译文叠在实时画面上；不知道原文语言时可用 'Detect language'。
好处：连无法输入的语言也能翻译。

ex.q: Which TWO technologies does Google Translate's camera mode use to translate a Japanese menu on screen?
ex.a: OCR to recognise the Japanese characters from the camera image, and AR to overlay the translated text onto the real-world view (plus machine translation).
ex.az: OCR 认字 + AR 叠加译文。

cards.t: Applications of AI and data science (overview)
cards.tz: AI 与数据科学的应用（总览）
cards.en:
The textbook's infographic lists everyday applications:
  • Machine translation (e.g. Google Translate, Computer-assisted Translation)
  • Autocorrect (suggesting words)
  • Digital assistants (chatbots, voice assistants using NLP)
  • Intelligent transport system (adaptive traffic signals, ETA prediction)
  • Route planning
  • Personalised marketing (recommendations)
  • Facial recognition
  • Monitoring health conditions through data from wearables
  • Expert system (gives professional advice like an expert, e.g. medical diagnosis)
Exam pattern: decide whether a scenario really 'involves AI'. A simple fixed calculation (e.g. average of exam scores) is not AI. Recognition, prediction or learning from data (facial recognition, speech recognition, friend recommendations) is AI.
cards.zh:
课本图表列出日常应用：
  • Machine translation 机器翻译
  • Autocorrect 自动更正
  • Digital assistants 数码助理（用 NLP）
  • Intelligent transport system 智能运输系统（自适应交通灯、预计到达时间）
  • Route planning 路线规划
  • Personalised marketing 个人化营销
  • Facial recognition
  • 用穿戴装置数据监察健康
  • Expert system 专家系统（像专家一样给专业建议，例如医疗诊断）
考试常见：判断情境是否'涉及 AI'。固定的简单计算（如计算平均分）不是 AI；识别、预测、从数据学习（人脸识别、语音识别、好友推荐）是 AI。

ex.q: Is calculating a student's average exam score an application of AI and big data? Explain.
ex.a: No. It is a fixed formula on a small data set; there is no learning from data, pattern recognition or prediction.
ex.az: 不是；只是固定公式计算，没有学习或预测。

cards.en:
In the era of big data, data science plays an important role in extracting useful information from data. Fields in data science (Fig. 1.16): business understanding, data mining, data cleaning, data exploration, feature engineering, predictive modelling, data visualisation.

Data mining (數據開採) is the process of sorting structured data to recognise patterns and establish relationships.

What is data science? We aim to process data and obtain useful information. Unlike the past when data were kept only on paper, data are now widely available on the Internet. APIs (Application Programming Interface) allow everyone to obtain data from different sources. Different statistical methods are then applied to analyse trends and patterns and extract meaningful insights. Flow in the figure: big data → classification → analysis → statistics → solving → knowledge → decision.
cards.zh:
大数据时代，data science（数据科学）负责从数据中提取有用资讯。范畴（图 1.16）：business understanding、data mining、data cleaning（数据清理）、data exploration、feature engineering、predictive modelling（预测建模）、data visualisation（数据视觉化）。

Data mining（数据开采）：sorting structured data to recognise patterns and establish relationships。

什么是数据科学？目的是处理数据并取得有用资讯。以前数据只记在纸上，现在网上随处可得；API（应用程式界面）让任何人从不同来源取得数据，再用统计方法分析趋势和规律，得出有意义的见解。图中流程：big data → classification → analysis → statistics → solving → knowledge → decision。

ex.q: A supermarket finds that customers who buy nappies often also buy beer. Which data science field is this, and why?
ex.a: Data mining: sorting structured sales data to recognise a pattern and establish a relationship between two products.
ex.az: 数据开采：从结构化销售数据中找出两件货品的关系。

cards.t: Relationship between IoT, big data, AI and data science
cards.tz: IoT、大数据、AI 与数据科学的关系
cards.en:
Big data, AI, data science and the IoT all work together (Fig. 1.17, a cycle):
  1. IoT → Big data: collect data. The IoT connects the Internet with different objects (phones, watches, cars, cards, cameras) to exchange information and build connections between data.
  2. Big data → AI: train model. Big data are analysed by AI through data science to figure out underlying principles and logic, so it can predict consumer behaviour, weather, traffic, etc.
  3. AI → IoT: automate tasks using intelligence. Humans can make data-driven decisions, and AI may perform duties automatically according to the analytical results.
Enrichment: automation with AI leads to workforce transition: workers need to learn new skills or even switch occupations.

Example: smart greenhouse. Sensors (IoT) collect temperature/humidity data → the model learns the best conditions → it switches the sprinkler or fan automatically.
cards.zh:
大数据、AI、数据科学和 IoT 互相配合（图 1.17 循环）：
  1. IoT → 大数据：收集数据（collect data）。IoT 把互联网和各种物件（手机、手表、汽车、卡、镜头）连接起来交换资讯。
  2. 大数据 → AI：训练模型（train model）。AI 透过数据科学分析大数据，找出背后的原理和逻辑，预测消费行为、天气、交通等。
  3. AI → IoT：智能地自动执行工作（automate tasks）。人类可作数据驱动决定，AI 也可按分析结果自动执行。
延伸：AI 自动化带来劳动力转型，工人要学新技能甚至转行。

例子：智能温室：感应器（IoT）收集温度/湿度 → 模型学习最佳条件 → 自动开洒水器或风扇。

ex.q: Describe the cycle for a real-time adaptive traffic signal system.
ex.a: Collect: sensors (IoT) detect vehicle and pedestrian flows → big data. Train/analyse: AI analyses the flows and predicts demand. Automate: the system adjusts the green time automatically, then new data are collected again.
ex.az: 感应器收集车流 → AI 分析预测 → 自动调整绿灯时间，再继续收集。

cards.t: Ethics of AI and data science
cards.tz: AI 与数据科学的伦理
cards.en:
AI and data science bring convenience and benefits, but also risks and ethical concerns, like all technology. Concerns range from:
  • Threats to privacy: massive collection of personal data (location, clicks, faces).
  • Discriminatory outcomes: biased training data give unfair decisions (e.g. hiring, loans).
  • Liability for unintended consequences on public safety: who is accountable when a self-driving car causes an accident (the owner, the manufacturer, the programmer)?
  • Using AI as a weapon.
It is important to develop new technology safely as well as with ethical values.

Misconception: 'AI is objective because it is a machine.' No. AI learns from data made by humans, so it can copy human bias. Activity 1.2 (music/video recommendation): advantages are personalised suggestions and discovering new content; disadvantages are privacy loss and narrow 'filter bubble' content. Protect privacy: read privacy policies, limit app permissions, clear cookies, use strong passwords and 2FA.
cards.zh:
AI 和数据科学带来方便，但和所有科技一样也有风险和伦理问题：
  • Threats to privacy 私隐威胁：大量收集个人数据（位置、点击、人脸）。
  • Discriminatory outcomes 歧视性结果：训练数据有偏差导致不公平决定（如招聘、贷款）。
  • 对公共安全意外后果的法律责任：自动驾驶车出事，车主、厂商还是程序员负责？
  • 把 AI 用作武器。
要安全地发展新科技并坚守伦理价值。

误解：'AI 是机器所以很客观'。错：AI 从人类制造的数据学习，会复制偏见。Activity 1.2（音乐/视频推荐）：优点是个人化推荐、发现新内容；缺点是失去私隐、内容变窄（信息茧房）。保护私隐：看私隐政策、限制 app 权限、清 cookies、强密码和双重认证。

ex.q: A company's AI hiring tool rejects more female applicants because past hires were mostly male. Which ethical concern is this? Suggest one fix.
ex.a: Discriminatory outcome caused by biased training data. Fix: use balanced, reviewed training data, remove gender-related features, and keep human review of decisions.
ex.az: 歧视性结果，来自有偏差的训练数据；改善：平衡数据、移除性别特征、保留人手审核。

cards.t: 3D printing: what it is and how it works
cards.en:
2D printers print on a page with ink or toner, while 3D printers eject materials like plastic, metal or even food to form 3D objects. Instead of printing one layer of ink, multiple layers are stacked upon each other to create complex 3D structures.

Process (Fig. 1.21, Fused Deposition Modelling (FDM)):
  1. A 3D model is first drawn with 3D design software.
  2. The 3D model file is 'sliced' into separate layers.
  3. Codes are generated to indicate the movements of the printing nozzle (噴嘴).
  4. The 3D printer follows the codes and builds the object layer by layer.
3D printing is an additive manufacturing method (adds material layer by layer), the opposite of subtractive manufacturing (cutting/machining material away from a block).
cards.zh:
2D 打印机用墨水或碳粉印在纸上；3D 打印机喷出塑胶、金属甚至食物等材料来形成立体物件。它不是印一层墨，而是一层一层叠起来造出复杂结构。

流程（图 1.21，FDM 熔融沉积成型）：
  1. 先用 3D 设计软件画 3D 模型。
  2. 把模型档'切片'（sliced）成多层。
  3. 生成代码，指示喷嘴（nozzle）的移动。
  4. 打印机按代码逐层建造物件。
3D 打印是additive manufacturing（加法制造），逐层加材料；相反的是 subtractive manufacturing（减法制造），从一整块材料切削。

ex.q: Put in order: (P) printer builds layer by layer, (Q) model sliced into layers, (R) model drawn in 3D software, (S) nozzle movement codes generated.
ex.a: R → Q → S → P: design the model, slice it, generate nozzle codes, then print layer by layer.
ex.az: R → Q → S → P。

cards.en:
3D printing is becoming more accessible and affordable with more free 3D design tools, 3D scanning apps, sharing sites for printable models, and budget 3D printers.

Three ways to get a 3D model:
  • Download: from a 3D model sharing platform, e.g. Thingiverse (3D printing model sharing site).
  • Scan: use a 3D scanner; widely used for building teeth models in dentistry.
  • Build: design yourself with free 3D design software, e.g. Tinkercad (easy-to-use online 3D design program) or SketchUp (advanced 3D modelling program).
Activity 1.3: download a model (e.g. a snowman maze puzzle printed with wood and plastic) and print it.

Watch out: downloaded files may be copyrighted, may contain design errors (not printable), or may come from untrusted sources.
cards.zh:
随着免费 3D 设计工具、3D 扫描 app、模型分享网站和平价 3D 打印机增加，3D 打印越来越普及和便宜。

取得 3D 模型的三种方法：
  • Download 下载：从 3D 模型分享平台，如 Thingiverse。
  • Scan 扫描：用 3D 扫描器，牙科常用来制作牙齿模型。
  • Build 自建：用免费设计软件，如 Tinkercad（易用的网上 3D 设计程式）或 SketchUp（进阶 3D 建模程式）。
Activity 1.3：下载一个模型（如用木和塑胶打印的雪人迷宫）并打印。

注意：下载的档案可能受版权保护、设计有错（印不出来）或来源不可靠。

ex.q: A dentist needs a model of a patient's teeth. Which method of 3D modelling is most suitable and why?
ex.a: Scan: a 3D scanner captures the exact shape of the patient's own teeth, which cannot be downloaded and would be hard to build by hand accurately.
ex.az: 扫描：能准确记录病人自己的牙齿形状。

cards.en:
Application areas (infographic):
  • Education: product prototypes (樣板), organ models, scientific equipment.
  • Food: reconstructed nutritious food for people who have difficulty swallowing or picky eaters.
  • Textile and fashion: sneaker midsoles (中層鞋底), dresses.
  • Space: tools, robots, spare parts, engine components (print in space instead of shipping).
  • Healthcare and medical: prosthetics (義肢), replacement organs, casts for broken bones, 3D aligners (牙套). 3D printing makes prosthetic hands more affordable.
  • Architecture and construction: houses, concept models, furniture.
  • Toy: spare parts, customised toys.
Common idea: each case needs customised, one-off or small-quantity items, or items that are hard to transport. That is where 3D printing beats mass production.
cards.zh:
应用范畴（图表）：
  • 教育：产品样板（prototypes）、器官模型、科学仪器。
  • 食物：为吞咽困难或偏食人士重组营养食物。
  • 纺织和时装：波鞋中层鞋底（midsole）、裙子。
  • 太空：工具、机械人、零件、引擎部件（在太空直接打印，不用运送）。
  • 医疗：义肢（prosthetics）、替换器官、骨折石膏、3D 牙套（aligners）；令义肢手更便宜。
  • 建筑：房屋、概念模型、家具。
  • 玩具：零件、订制玩具。
共通点：都需要订制、单件或少量的物品，或难以运送的物品，这正是 3D 打印胜过大量生产的地方。

ex.q: Why is 3D printing especially useful on a space station?
ex.a: Spare parts and tools can be printed on demand on board instead of being shipped from Earth, which is slow and very expensive; only raw material needs to be stored.
ex.az: 可以在太空站按需要打印零件，不用从地球运送。

cards.en:
Table 1.3:
  • Time-saving: additive manufacturing method; faster prototyping than subtractive manufacturing; rapid verification and production of design ideas.
  • Lower cost: one-step production; greatly minimises the cost of different manufacturing processes (machining, welding, painting, etc.); reduces labour costs with fewer factory workers.
  • Tailor-made: more affordable and easier to create customised products without moulding.
  • Sustainability: uses materials and reduces waste compared with subtractive manufacturing; reuses plastic waste as printing material; reduces shipping's carbon footprint with local production.
The cartoon shows one person pressing START on a 3D printer, versus a production line of many workers (mould, cut, paint).

Note: these benefits are strongest for small-scale/custom production. For mass production of identical items, moulding is still cheaper and faster per piece.
cards.zh:
表 1.3：
  • Time-saving 省时：加法制造；比减法制造更快做出样板；快速验证和生产设计构思。
  • Lower cost 成本低：一步生产；大减各种工序（机械加工、焊接、上色）的成本；工人少，降低人工成本。
  • Tailor-made 度身订造：不用模具就能更便宜、更容易做订制产品。
  • Sustainability 可持续：比减法制造少浪费材料；回收塑胶废料作打印材料；本地生产减少运输碳足印。
漫画：一人按 START 用 3D 打印机，对比一条要很多工人（倒模、切割、上色）的生产线。

注意：这些优点在小量/订制生产最明显；大量生产相同物件时，倒模每件仍更便宜更快。

ex.q: Suggest TWO advantages of using a 3D printer to make a personalised birthday gift.
ex.a: 1. Tailor-made/customised: the gift can be designed uniquely (e.g. with the friend's name) without a mould. 2. Lower cost / faster for one item: one-step production at home, no factory processes or minimum order.
ex.az: 1. 可度身订造，不用模具；2. 单件一步生产，便宜快捷。

cards.en:
Table 1.4 Impacts of 3D printing:
  • Intellectual property challenges: it becomes easier and cheaper to create fakes by 3D scanning, and illegal file sharing and downloading; more home printing of replacement or spare parts; current IP law needs to be updated.
  • Community safety: 3D printable files for guns were available to the public online; undetectable 3D-printed plastic firearms threaten human life and safety.
  • Industrial revolution: more environmentally friendly and cheaper than traditional manufacturing in small-scale production; brings more fierce competition; decentralisation of local production (factory workers may lose jobs as items can be printed at home).
Copyright (Checkpoint 1.2 Q2): in Hong Kong, sharing copyrighted 3D printable files with friends without permission is most likely infringement. Designing your own model and printing it as a gift is fine.
cards.zh:
表 1.4 3D 打印的影响：
  • 知识产权挑战：用 3D 扫描更容易更便宜造假货，非法分享和下载档案；在家打印替换零件增加；现行 IP 法例需更新。
  • 社区安全：网上公开流传枪械打印档；侦测不到的 3D 打印塑胶枪威胁生命安全。
  • 工业革命：小规模生产时比传统制造更环保更便宜；竞争更激烈；本地生产分散化（东西可在家印，工厂工人可能失业）。
版权（Checkpoint 1.2 Q2）：在香港，未经许可把受版权保护的 3D 打印档分享给朋友最可能侵权；自己设计模型再印出来送人则没有问题。

ex.q: State one potential problem of printing 3D model files downloaded from the Internet.
ex.a: The file may be copyrighted, so printing/sharing it without permission may infringe intellectual property. (Also accept: the model may contain errors/be unprintable, or may be a dangerous item such as a gun part.)
ex.az: 可能侵犯版权（或模型有错、是危险物品）。

cards.en:
3D visualisation is much more realistic than images normally shown on paper, computer, TV or cinema. People get a greater sense of depth than with 2D images and feel they could reach out and touch the objects.

Table 1.5 methods:
  • 3D glasses (e.g. red/cyan or polarised glasses in cinemas)
  • Autostereoscopic display: shows 3D without glasses on a special screen
  • AR (Augmented Reality)
  • VR (Virtual Reality)
  • Hologram
Quick distinction: VR replaces the real world; AR adds to the real world; a hologram is seen with bare eyes without a headset or phone.
cards.zh:
3D visualisation（3D 视觉化）比纸、电脑、电视或戏院的影像更逼真，比 2D 有更强的深度感，好像伸手就摸到。

表 1.5 方法：
  • 3D glasses 3D 眼镜（如戏院的红蓝或偏光眼镜）
  • Autostereoscopic display 裸眼 3D 显示器：特别屏幕，不用眼镜
  • AR 扩增实境
  • VR 虚拟实境
  • Hologram 全息影像
速记：VR 取代真实世界；AR 加到真实世界；hologram 用肉眼就看到，不用头戴装置或手机。

ex.q: Which 3D visualisation method lets an audience see a 3D performer on stage without wearing any device?
ex.a: A hologram: its virtual images can be seen with bare eyes, unlike VR/AR which need a headset or screen.
ex.az: 全息影像：肉眼可见。

cards.en:
Virtual Reality (VR, 虛擬實境) is a computer-simulated environment (電腦模擬環境) which gives users a feeling of being in the virtual environment.

Two types of immersive virtual world (Table 1.6):
  • Imagination: made of 3D models by computer-aided design (CAD) software (e.g. dinosaurs).
  • Replication (複製): captured by 360-degree cameras to present real scenes from all over the world.
Hardware (Fig. 1.23, VR tricks our brain):
  • VR headsets create an immersive experience by totally taking over one's vision. Phone-based headsets need a smartphone and are cheaper; independent headsets have a built-in processor, display and audio, and are more expensive.
  • Controllers allow virtual interactivity. Remote controllers use navigator buttons and are cheaper; motion controllers use motion sensors and are more expensive; full-body trackers track body movements into VR and are more expensive.
Activity 1.4: watch 'Along the River During the Qingming Festival VR' on YouTube in VR mode (split screen), put the phone into a cardboard headset; without a headset, turn the device or drag the scene.
cards.zh:
Virtual Reality（VR，虚拟实境）是电脑模拟环境，让用户感觉置身虚拟环境中。

两种沉浸式虚拟世界（表 1.6）：
  • Imagination 想像：用电脑辅助设计（CAD）软件造的 3D 模型（如恐龙）。
  • Replication 复制：用 360 度相机拍摄世界各地的真实场景。
硬件（图 1.23）：
  • VR 头戴装置：完全占据视野，营造沉浸感。手机式要用智能手机，较便宜；独立式内置处理器、显示屏和音响，较贵。
  • 控制器提供互动：遥控器用导航按钮，较便宜；动作控制器用动作感应器，较贵；全身追踪器把身体动作转到 VR，较贵。
Activity 1.4：在 YouTube 看《清明上河图》VR，开 VR 模式（分屏），手机放入纸盒头戴装置；没有头戴装置可转动手机或拖动画面。

ex.q: A museum wants visitors to 'walk' inside the real Forbidden City from Hong Kong. Imagination or replication? Which hardware?
ex.a: Replication: film the real place with 360-degree cameras. Visitors use VR headsets (phone-based ones are cheaper for many visitors) with simple controllers.
ex.az: 复制：用 360 度相机拍真实场景；用 VR 头戴装置观看。

cards.en:
VR is used for many purposes apart from gaming, e.g. training simulators for soldiers, pilots and doctors. Textbook examples:
  • Media: VR cinema
  • Gaming: VR games
  • Military: VR soldier training
  • Healthcare: VR surgery (training)
  • Theme park: VR coaster (headsets transport riders into a fictional world on roller coasters)
  • Education: VR solar system
  • Sports: Olympics VR live streams
  • Map: Google Map Street View VR
Ethics prompt: VR can let people 'reunite' with deceased loved ones and say goodbye. Is it good or bad? (Comfort vs emotional dependence, consent to use a person's data.)

Why training uses VR: virtual hands-on practice with lower risk of failure in real life, repeatable and cheaper than real equipment.
cards.zh:
VR 除了游戏，还用于很多范畴，例如士兵、机师、医生的训练模拟器。课本例子：
  • 媒体：VR 戏院
  • 游戏
  • 军事：士兵训练
  • 医疗：VR 手术（训练）
  • 主题乐园：VR 过山车（头戴装置把乘客带进虚构世界）
  • 教育：VR 太阳系
  • 体育：奥运 VR 直播
  • 地图：Google 街景 VR
伦理思考：VR 让人和已故亲人'重聚'道别，是好是坏？（安慰 vs 情感依赖、使用死者资料的同意）

训练用 VR 的原因：虚拟实践，现实中失败风险低，可重复练习，比真实设备便宜。

ex.q: Give TWO advantages of training surgeons with VR instead of on real patients.
ex.a: 1. Lower risk: mistakes do not harm real patients. 2. Repeatable and flexible: procedures can be practised many times, anytime, at lower cost than real operating rooms.
ex.az: 1. 风险低，不会伤及病人；2. 可重复、随时练习，成本低。

cards.en:
Augmented Reality (AR, 擴增實境) is the concept of overlaying digital images and information onto our real world. Examples: overlaying a furniture model onto the floor, a makeup filter onto the face, additional information displayed on AR smart glasses.

VR vs AR: VR removes the real world and transports you to a fictional one; AR aims to enhance your real-world experience by adding virtual objects to it.

Table 1.7 methods of making the 3D overlay:
  • Imagination: made of 3D models by computer-aided design software (e.g. a virtual cake).
  • Replication: captured by 3D scanning (e.g. a scanned elephant toy shown on a phone).
Typical trigger: the phone camera recognises a marker image or surface, then draws the 3D model on top, and moving the camera shows it from different perspectives (e.g. the heart model in Long Question 3).
cards.zh:
Augmented Reality（AR，扩增实境）是把数码影像和资讯叠加在真实世界上。例子：把家具模型放在地板上、在脸上加化妆滤镜、在 AR 智能眼镜上显示额外资讯。

VR vs AR：VR 移除真实世界，带你进入虚构世界；AR 加入虚拟物件来增强真实世界的体验。

表 1.7 制作 3D 叠加物的方法：
  • Imagination 想像：用 CAD 软件造 3D 模型（如虚拟蛋糕）。
  • Replication 复制：用 3D 扫描取得（如扫描大象玩具后在手机显示）。
常见运作：手机镜头认出标记图像或平面，再在上面画出 3D 模型，移动镜头就能从不同角度观看（如长题 3 的心脏模型）。

ex.q: Susan scans an image with her phone and a 3D heart appears, which she can view from different angles. What technology is used, and how does it help learning?
ex.a: Augmented Reality (AR). It helps learning by letting students visualise the 3D structure of the heart from different perspectives, which is more interactive and easier to understand than a 2D picture.
ex.az: AR；让学生从不同角度看立体结构，更互动易明。

cards.en:
Like VR, AR is used in many fields:
  • Education: AR 3D anatomy
  • Military: pilot's heads-up display (HUD)
  • Architecture: AR concept models
  • Entertainment: face filter apps
  • Gaming: AR tower defence games
  • Healthcare: dental treatment with AR glasses; physicians perform minimally invasive surgery (微創手術) with live X-ray and medical images shown on smart glasses
  • Automobile: AR labels and instructions for repair
  • Travel and tourism: AR navigation in a map app; AR walking directions in live view showing nearby restaurants and shops
  • Retail: furniture preview, virtual try-on of makeup/clothes
Activity 1.5 Instant translation: Google Translate camera mode uses OCR + AR. Steps: open the app and tap 'Camera'; select source and target languages; point the camera at the menu, and the source text is overlaid with the translation.
cards.zh:
和 VR 一样，AR 用于很多范畴：
  • 教育：AR 3D 解剖
  • 军事：机师抬头显示器（HUD）
  • 建筑：AR 概念模型
  • 娱乐：人脸滤镜 app
  • 游戏：AR 塔防游戏
  • 医疗：AR 眼镜辅助牙科治疗；医生借智能眼镜上的实时 X 光和医学影像做微创手术
  • 汽车：AR 维修标签和指示
  • 旅游：地图 app 的 AR 导航；实景AR 步行指示并显示附近餐厅和商店
  • 零售：预览家具、虚拟试化妆/衣服
Activity 1.5 即时翻译：Google Translate 相机模式用 OCR + AR。步骤：开 app 按 'Camera'；选来源和目标语言；镜头对准餐牌，原文会被译文覆盖。

ex.q: A fashion brand closes physical stores and adds AR try-on to its app. State one drawback of this decision.
ex.a: Widening the digital divide: customers without suitable smartphones or skills cannot shop or try on products. (Also: privacy concerns over camera/face data.)
ex.az: 扩大数码鸿沟：没有合适手机或技能的顾客无法使用。

cards.en:
Hologram (全息影像): unlike VR and AR, virtual images produced by holograms can be seen with bare eyes, with no headset, glasses or phone screen needed. Examples: the Star Wars hologram at Walt Disney World Resort; the Michael Jackson hologram at the Billboard Music Awards.

Activity 1.6 DIY hologram projector: a holographic pyramid can create a virtual world on your table with a transparent pyramid reflecting the video shown on the screen.
  1. Make a hologram projector (pyramid) from a plastic bottle following the video.
  2. Play a hologram video (four copies of the image, one per side, on a black background) on your smart device.
  3. Place the DIY projector on top of the device; each side reflects one image so a floating 3D-looking object appears in the middle.
Exam distinction: if the question says 'no special equipment for the viewer' or 'seen by a crowd', the answer is hologram.
cards.zh:
Hologram（全息影像）：和 VR、AR 不同，全息影像用肉眼就能看到，不用头戴装置、眼镜或手机屏幕。例子：迪士尼世界的星球大战全息影像；Billboard 音乐颁奖礼的米高积逊全息影像。

Activity 1.6 DIY 全息投影器：全息金字塔用透明金字塔反射屏幕上的视频，在桌上造出虚拟世界。
  1. 按影片用胶樽做投影器（金字塔）。
  2. 在智能装置播放全息视频（黑底上四个方向各一个影像）。
  3. 把投影器放在装置上；每一面反射一个影像，中间就出现浮空的立体物件。
考试分辨：题目说'观众不需特别装置'或'一大群人同时看'，答案是 hologram。

ex.q: Why does a hologram video show four copies of the same object?
ex.a: The transparent pyramid has four faces; each face reflects one copy towards the viewer on that side, so the object appears to float in the centre from all four viewing directions.
ex.az: 金字塔有四面，每面反射一个影像，令物件从四个方向看都浮在中间。

cards.en:
BenefitsLimitations
  • Virtual hands-on training and lower risk of failure in real life
  • More flexible: anytime and anywhere
  • Lower cost
  • Digital divide caused by the inability to access the devices
  • Privacy and security concerns about data collection by AR (camera, location, face)
  • Being less aware of the surroundings (accidents while wearing a headset/walking with AR)
  • Technical expertise is required
Also (Long Question 2): prolonged VR use may cause eye strain, dizziness/motion sickness, addiction, reduced real social contact; uploading selfies and body measurements to a VR platform risks privacy leakage / identity theft / misuse of personal data.

Education (Checkpoint 1.3 Q1): AR/VR offer alternatives to real field trips and experiments, enhance engagement and deepen understanding. Widening the digital divide is a drawback, not a benefit.
cards.zh:
好处限制
  • 虚拟实践训练，现实中失败风险低
  • 更灵活：随时随地
  • 成本较低
  • 无法取得装置造成数码鸿沟
  • AR 收集数据引起私隐和保安问题（镜头、位置、人脸）
  • 对周围环境警觉性降低（戴头戴装置或边走边用 AR 容易出意外）
  • 需要技术知识
另外（长题 2）：长时间用 VR 可能令眼睛疲劳、头晕/晕动症、沉迷、减少真实社交；把自拍和身体尺寸上传到 VR 平台有私隐外泄、身份盗用、个人资料被滥用的风险。

教育（Checkpoint 1.3 Q1）：AR/VR 可代替实地考察和实验、提高投入感、加深理解；扩大数码鸿沟是缺点不是好处。

ex.q: State TWO possible risks of using a VR headset for 6 hours every day.
ex.a: 1. Health problems: eye strain, dizziness/motion sickness, neck strain. 2. Addiction / less real-life social interaction. (Also: injuries from being less aware of the surroundings.)
ex.az: 1. 眼睛疲劳、头晕等健康问题；2. 沉迷、减少现实社交。

(2) Crowdedness predictions in Google Map
(3) Google Translate

mc.ez: 三者都从大量数据学习来生成或预测。

(2) Live traffic conditions provided by drivers

(2) It is cheaper for small production.
(3) It is more flexible to modify the design.

mc.ez: 也可用金属、食物，(4) 错。

Sharing copyrighted 3D printable files with friends without permission
Searching for 3D printable files using peer-to-peer file sharing software
Designing 3D models and printing it out as a gift
mc.e: Distributing copyrighted files without permission infringes copyright.
mc.ez: 未经许可分享受版权保护的档案属侵权。
